description: Source code for the Python bindings of the XPU Stream class in PyTorch, implementing stream creation, management, and querying functionalities.

classes.name: THXPStream
classes.description: Python object representing an XPU stream, wrapping at::xpu::XPUStream.

methods.name: THXPStream_pynew
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new THXPStream object with optional parameters.

methods.name: THXPStream_dealloc
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up THXPStream object.

methods.name: THXPStream_get_sycl_queue
methods.description: Returns the SYCL queue associated with the stream.

methods.name: THXPStream_get_priority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the stream.

methods.name: THXPStream_priority_range
methods.description: Returns the range of valid priorities for streams.

methods.name: THXPStream_query
methods.description: Checks if the stream has completed all tasks.

methods.name: THXPStream_synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the stream, blocking until all tasks are complete.

methods.name: THXPStream_eq
methods.description: Checks equality between two stream objects.

methods.name: THXPStream_init
methods.description: Initializes the THXPStream type and adds it to the module.
